description: 1.3 — Economy loop, where armies come from (overview), and building units.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Income ◦ At the start of your turn, every structure you control pays +100 BISMUTH. ◦ Spend BISMUTH to recruit units and react to threats.Faction bonuses change how fast you earn — those details come in the Ertrian, Virix, and Sentus lessons.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Where units are produced Each Progeny builds from different structures: ◦ Ertrians — Factories and Airports ◦ Virix — any BISMUTH tile you own ◦ Sentus — PortalsThe next tutorials dive into what makes each faction tick.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Producing units ◦ Select a production structure to see which units are available this turn. ◦ Press the unit button to build it on that structure.◦ You cannot build on a structure while another unit is standing on it — clear the pad first.
